description: Generate images, video, music, speech and text with 60+ models through your MostAI account.
name: io.github.most-ai-com/mostai-mcp

environmentVariables.description: MostAI session cookie. Optional: normally captured by `mostai-login` and stored in the system keyring; set this only for headless/CI use.
environmentVariables.name: MOSTAI_COOKIE

environmentVariables.description: Generations costing this many RUB or more return needs_confirmation instead of charging (default 50; 0 disables the gate).
environmentVariables.name: MOSTAI_WARN_PRICE

environmentVariables.description: Optional absolute hard cap in RUB: generations above it are refused outright (unset = no cap).
environmentVariables.name: MOSTAI_MAX_PRICE
